|lore=BlasTech DL-44 heavy blaster pistol. Short range, but relatively powerful. Carries energy for 25 shots. Illegal or restricted in most systems.
|game_text=Deploy on Beckett or non-spy Han. May target a character. Draw destiny. Target hit, and its forfeit = 0, if destiny +2 &gt; defense value. If on Han, may fire once during your control phase, and may place this weapon in Used Pile to cancel a weapon destiny targeting Han.

|errata_history=This is the errata version PC-E1 (version 2 of 5) of the Virtual Modern card. It is not the current text; the current text is [[Han's Heavy Blaster Pistol (V) (Errata 4)]] (PC-E4). '''What changed on the card image''' (crops of the two published images, pixels unchanged): [[File:V0-L-hansheavyblasterpistol-PC-E1-change-before.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] before ([[:File:V0-L-hansheavyblasterpistol-original.gif]], 8 July 2018) → [[File:V0-L-hansheavyblasterpistol-PC-E1-change-after.png|frameless|upright=1.1]] after ([[:File:V0-L-hansheavyblasterpistol-PC-E1.gif]], 12 May 2020).

The commit date is the upload date; the PC's errata announcement may differ by days.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier, in Virtual Set 0, and no earlier copy of its text was found). Document: no errata mark; the bottom margin prints “•Han's Heavy Blaster Pistol” (with the uniqueness dot). Text: “Deploy on Han (except TK-422), even as a 'react.'
